subject: general
question:
Three segments of the following sentence have been underlined and given as options. One of them may contain an error. Select the option that contains the error. If you don’t find any error, mark ‘No error’ as your answer.

__When my father will come__, __I will make sure__ that __I discuss the possibilities__ of a new business venture with him.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"When"** is used to introduce a time clause and often does not require a future tense verb. (जब)

 
 
• **Example: When** he arrives, we will start the meeting.
 
 
 
• **"Will" **is used to express future actions or states, but it is not required after "when" in the time clause. (करेंगे)
 
 
• **Example: **We **will **meet when the show ends.
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct phrase should be **"When my father comes"** instead of **"When my father will come".**

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **No error **(कोई त्रुटि नहीं): Indicates that the sentence segment is correct.

 
 
• **Example:** The sentence "She sings beautifully" has no error.
 
 
 
• **I discuss the possibilities **(मैं संभावनाओं पर चर्चा करता हूं): Correct usage in the context of future plans.
 
 
• **Example: **I discuss the possibilities with my team every Monday.
 
 
 
• **I will make sure **(मैं सुनिश्चित करूंगा): Correct usage to indicate a future intention.
 
 
• **Example:** I will make sure that everyone gets the message.
